title: Himuro no Tenchi: Fate/school Life
titleNative: 氷室の天地 Fate/school life
synopsis: Fate/school life is a comedy 4-koma manga revolving around the normal life at school of the minor characters of Fate/stay night and Fate/Hollow Ataraxia, specifically the character Himuro Kane, classmate of Fate/stay night protagonist Emiya Shirou. This manga by Mashin Eiichirou is a spin-off that tells the normal school life of the supporting characters Himuro Kane, Makidera Kaede, Saegusa Yukika. Other characters are the regular cast of the main games: Mitsuzuri Ayako, Tohsaka Rin, Ryuudou Issei, Matou Shinji, Emiya Shirou, Kuzuki Souichirou, Fujimura Taiga, Matou Sakura, Mitsuzuri Minori; "guest" characters from other series Ciel, Seven, Sajyou Ayaka (formerly the heroine of the never finished prototype novel of Fate/stay night) are also featured, and other classmates Gotou Gai, Fujimoto, Dezaki, Hirumata. The story is centered around classic school events such as a ball game tournament, field trips and inter high school competitions. As such, there is no reference at all to supernatural things like magecraft and Heroic Spirits. br> Note: Includes 18 extra chapters.

synopsis: Kazuki Ishii has his life turned upside down — and is driven to suicide — after getting caught up in the romantic entanglements of his friend Teruhito Amada, who is wildly popular with the opposite sex, like the hero of a romantic comedy. However, a miracle occurs, and time is rewound back to the morning of his high school entrance ceremony. In his second chance at life, Kazuki tries to keep a low profile, avoid making friends, and live a peaceful life. But for some reason, Meiko Hikata — Amada’s childhood friend and a cool beauty known as the “Ice Empress”—begins to take an interest in him. (Source: Natalie, translated)

I Reincarnated as a Villainous Noble Fated to Lose, but Got Obsessed with Magic
synopsis: The villainous noble, Zenon Restinatra, is a disappointing "underdog" who gets beaten up by the protagonist in the original anime. "I," a mere fan of the original work, have possessed such a Zenon!? This place is completely the world of the anime, and when I tried out magic for starters, it was super fun. I've decided... I'm going to change Zenon's disappointing ending! The "do-over" life of a magic maniac begins!! (Source: Kodansha, translated)

If They Find Out I'm a Mandrake, Do I Get Slayed...?
synopsis: Having met an unfortunate end, Misaki is reincarnated as an extraordinary mandrake that transforms into a deadly monster just by screaming! Determined to finally enjoy a happy (human?) life, she manages to take on a human form, but her inability to speak causes all sorts of misunderstandings, leading people to worship her as the "Flower Witch"... While dreading being hunted if her true nature is revealed, she struggles to achieve a peaceful life!!
